units.policy: AI should not replace reading course materials.
units.why: "Replace reading course materials" bars using AI in place of reading; P105 is the nearest ban, but it says "replace", not a ban on all AI use with readings, and the page permits summarizing complex readings.
units.fit_note: Bars replacing reading with AI; does not ban all AI use on readings, and the same page permits summarizing complex readings. | Bans replacing reading, while another line lists summarizing readings as a possible use.

units.passage: including, but not limited to: summarizing texts, transcribing notes, brainstorming topic or QFE ideas, or producing assignment text (even if only for a preliminary draft).
units.policy: Generative AI is not allowed for summarizing texts, transcribing notes, or brainstorming topic or QFE ideas.
units.why: The ban lists "summarizing texts, transcribing notes, brainstorming topic or QFE ideas". Banning AI for summarizing readings is P105.
units.fit_note: Also bans transcribing notes and brainstorming. Also bans brainstorming and drafting; P105 chosen for the reading and summarizing ban.
